UserAccount.title: User Account Anchor
UserAccount.description: Root ownership anchor document proving authenticated user existence without storing PII.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account owner

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set on initial account creation

UserPrivateProfile.title: User Private Contact Profile
UserPrivateProfile.description: Isolated PII document holding optional contact phone number, email address, emergency contact, and localized care preferences.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner

phone.description: Optional Nigerian or international contact phone number

emergencyContactPhone.description: Optional family or emergency contact phone number

preferredState.description: Saved Nigerian state or FCT for localized hospital routing

preferredLanguage.description: Saved UI and triage language preference

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest profile save

SavedCheckup.title: Saved Triage Checkup
SavedCheckup.description: User-initiated saved summary from public (non-private) symptom triage evaluations.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner

symptomSummary.description: Short summary of the symptom query

state.description: Nigerian state used during hospital routing

isRedFlag.description: Whether emergency red-flag warning signs triggered

nextStepSummary.description: Summary of advised next step and hospital care guidance

recommendedFacilities.description: Bounded list of up to 5 recommended public hospitals

/users/{userId}.description: Root account ownership anchor per verified Firebase user.

/users/{userId}/private/{docId}.description: Owner-only PII subcollection storing 'profile' (email, phone, emergency contact, state, language). Strictly never shared or listed.

/users/{userId}/checkups/{checkupId}.description: Owner-only saved public triage summaries. Private Care (HIV/PEP/ART) data is strictly never written to Firestore.
